title: Merchandise Purchases — Incident Escalation Credit on Gift Card Claims
content:
**Escalation rule.** The incident escalation credit on a Merchandise Purchases gift card claim is set once for the whole incident, on the gift card claim, from the register-error corrections standing on the unit:

| Register-error corrections on the unit's records | Incident escalation credit |
|---|---|
| at least 3 (the high correction count) | high credit, $25.00 |
| exactly 2 (the middle correction count) | middle credit, $15.00 |
| exactly 1 (the low correction count) | low credit, $5.00 |

A unit whose records carry no register-error correction is outside this rule.

The count is of the price adjustment entries on the unit's records whose reason is register price error, as they stand when the gift card claim is set.

## Reading the count (hypothetical records)

| Entries on the unit | Count | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| four register-error corrections | 4 | $25.00 |
| three register-error corrections | 3 | $25.00 |
| two register-error corrections and one price-drop adjustment | 2 | $15.00 |
| one register-error correction | 1 | $5.00 |
| price-drop adjustments only | 0 | outside this rule |
